verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS email platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a way for the account holder to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The open/click tracking feature (mailersend-docs-13) covers recipient engagement analytics, a different capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
